jobs.description:
Role Purpose
Drive the optimization of metallurgical processes across the aluminium extrusion value chain. 
Ensure consistent product quality and strengthen operational excellence through expertise in alloys, heat treatment, and process performance. Collaborate with research, operations, commercial teams, customers, institutes, and universities to solve technical challenges and develop advanced aluminium extrusion solutions.
What you will be doing
Provide metallurgical expertise for aluminium extrusion operations, including casting, homogenization, extrusion, quenching, stretching, and aging
Develop, evaluate, and qualify new alloys, process technologies, and extrusion products
Develop and optimize alloy performance for mechanical and functional properties, extrusion productivity, and sustainability
Collaborate with production teams to establish process standards and best practices
Support customer projects with technical expertise and metallurgical guidance
Support root cause analysis and problem-solving for quality issues related to alloy selection, mechanical properties, and geometrical stability
Conduct metallurgical investigations, laboratory testing, and failure analyses
Prepare technical reports, specifications, and customer documentation
Ensure work is performed in compliance with the Hydro Quality system, HSE regulations, policies, and standardized operating procedures
Perform other tasks assigned by the responsible manager that support the operation of the unit and comply with applicable laws and company rules
Comply with area-specific customer requirements

What will make you successful?
PhD or Master’s degree in Physical Metallurgy, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline
Strong knowledge of aluminium alloys
Knowledge of heat treatment, precipitation hardening, recrystallization, grain structure control, and mechanical property development
Familiarity with metallography, microscopy, hardness testing, tensile testing, quality systems, ISO standards, and customer qualification requirements is preferred
Experience in aluminium extrusion, aluminium processing, or a metallurgical manufacturing environment
Practical experience with metallurgical testing and analysis techniques
Experience with automotive, building systems, industrial, electrical, or renewable energy applications is preferred
Knowledge of adjacent fields such as corrosion, extrusion simulation, or process modelling is an advantage
Familiarity with data analytics tools, including Power BI and Python, is an asset
Fluent English and Swedish both written and spoken
Curious, data-driven, and motivated to solve complex technical challenges
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
Ability to combine deep metallurgical knowledge with practical manufacturing understanding
Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills
Able to work effectively with research, operational, commercial, customer, and academic partners
Focused on measurable improvements in product performance, quality, operational efficiency, and customer success

What we offer you
A high-impact role in advanced manufacturing projects
Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technologies
International collaboration and exposure across sites
A dynamic and hands-on technical environment
Autonomy and responsibility in driving process improvements
Travel opportunities and involvement in on-site operations
A strong culture of quality, safety, and continuous learning

Your role
We are looking for a leader who is passionate about developing people, creating structure, and driving continuous improvement in a complex technical environment.
 
As Team Manager Infrastructure Office, you will lead a team of highly skilled specialists organized in two Scrum teams. The team plays a critical role in enabling and supporting one of Atlas Copco's strategic software platforms, providing the infrastructure, tools, and expertise needed to develop the next generation of connected products.
 
This is a leadership role where your success will be measured by your ability to develop people, create structure, drive continuous improvement, and ensure delivery in a business-critical environment.

Your responsibilities will include:
Leading, coaching, and developing the team and its individuals
Driving process development, quality assurance, and operational excellence
Managing recruitment, competence development, and resource planning
Overseeing the infrastructure, tools, and platform capabilities that support software development across R&D
Ensuring efficient operation of server infrastructure used for testing and software compilation
Supporting production testing and helping resolve business-critical customer issues where hardware and software intersect
Securing and developing key competencies within the team, including specialized Wi-Fi expertise
Collaborating with stakeholders across R&D to support current and future platform needs

 
You will be part of the department management team and contribute to the continued development of our software platforms, engineering capabilities, and ways of working. The Infrastructure Office is part of a newly formed department within R&D.

 
Your skills and experience
We believe you are an experienced leader who enjoys building high-performing teams and creating clarity in complex environments.
 
You bring:
Experience leading teams as a manager, project leader, or similar leadership role
A strong ability to drive change, improve processes, and establish efficient ways of working
Experience working in software development organizations
Understanding of embedded software development, Devops and Linux-based environments
Experience working with agile teams and Scrum methodologies
Strong communication, planning, and stakeholder management skills
Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken

 
As a person, you are structured, collaborative, and able to balance operational priorities with long-term development. You empower others, build trust, and create the conditions for your team to succeed. You are comfortable leading experienced specialists and are able to navigate both strategic discussions and urgent operational challenges.
 
Your job location
 
This position is based in Nacka, Stockholm, Sweden. Extensive collaboration takes place across our global R&D organization, providing opportunities to work with colleagues around the world.
Application process
Our selection process includes interviews, skills assessments and a background check. We look forward to getting to know you, learning about your strengths, and discussing how you can grow with us.

We are seeking a Senior Buyer for an international company in the powertrain industry. This role offers the opportunity to develop sourcing strategies and supplier partnerships for engine systems and accessories in a technically complex environment.
Working alongside procurement colleagues in Europe and Asia, you will collaborate with stakeholders across R&D, business strategy, manufacturing, logistics, supplier quality and aftermarket. Your focus will be to secure production materials that meet quality, cost and delivery requirements while supporting competitive powertrain solutions.
The position combines strategic sourcing with day-to-day purchasing responsibilities. You will also have opportunities to contribute beyond your core area, broaden your expertise and develop professionally.
Your responsibilities

Lead and develop purchasing activities for base engine components.

Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities.

Act as the primary commercial contact for suppliers.

Conduct market benchmarking and supplier assessments.

Manage strategic sourcing activities and commercial negotiations.

Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align purchasing decisions with business and technical needs.

Manage purchase orders, agreements and related documentation.

Develop and optimise the supplier base to strengthen performance and long-term value.

Your profile
You are commercially minded, results-oriented and comfortable working with complex challenges. You identify opportunities, propose practical solutions and constructively challenge established approaches.
You build effective working relationships and bring integrity, accountability and a collaborative approach to your work. You can manage several projects simultaneously, set clear priorities and deliver against agreed objectives. You also take an active interest in developing your skills.
Your background

A university degree in business or engineering, or equivalent qualifications.

Two to five years of experience in commercial and/or engineering roles, including commercial negotiations.

Relevant legal knowledge, particularly in relation to purchasing and contracts.

Strong business judgement and the ability to organise your work and meet deadlines.

Excellent written and spoken communication skills in both Swedish and English.

Application & Start Date
Start Date: 2026-12-07
End Date: 2027-09-30
Application Deadline: 2026-11-17
Location: Gothenburg
Selections and interviews are ongoing!
Sway Sourcing is an innovative recruitment partner specializing in matching the right talent with the right company—quickly and efficiently. Our primary focus lies in Finance, Administration, HR, Marketing, and IT, but we also have the broad expertise and flexibility required to deliver tailored recruitment solutions across all industries.
Although we are a relatively new player, we have already gained the trust of many of Sweden's largest companies and operate both nationally and internationally. With bases in Sweden and Spain, we offer a unique combination of local expertise and global reach. Our strong network and deep industry insights make us the obvious partner for companies looking to stay ahead in their recruitment efforts.

Are you ready to take the next step in your career in auditing? We are looking for a Senior Audit Consultant with at least 5 years of professional experience to join our Audit Assurance team based in Stockholm. Regardless of your current level of experience, we offer an opportunity to grow and develop together with us.
The Opportunity:
 As an Audit Consultant, you will work on meaningful projects that give you significant influence over your workday. You will have the chance to grow with us and work with everything from small owner-managed companies to large listed corporations. You will become part of our global network of specialists and take on challenging tasks from day one. EY values teamwork, respect, and integrity, which form the foundation of our shared success.
Responsibilities:
Lead and execute audit engagements together with your team.
Maintain strong communication with key stakeholders and provide ongoing updates on the audit process.
Complete audit processes efficiently.
Continuously deepen your understanding of current regulations and processes, and share your knowledge to support and develop junior colleagues.
Understand our clients’ unique ambitions and needs, and share your insights with colleagues to improve our work.

Skills and Attributes for Success:
 We are looking for curious individuals ready to collaborate and build relationships with colleagues and clients. You should have a strong goal orientation and ambition to develop, as well as a passion for delivering professional service. In return, we offer support, coaching, and training to help you grow in your career.
Qualifications for the Role:
Relevant university degree
At least 5 years of professional experience in auditing
Experience working with audits for both large and small companies
Fluency in English (spoken and written)

What We Offer:
Continuous Learning: Develop skills for the future
Success Your Way: Tools and flexibility to make a difference
Transformational Leadership: Insights and coaching to become a leader
Inclusive Culture: Acceptance of who you are and the opportunity to help others

Are you ready to Shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
 Please submit your application no later than 24 December 2026. Selection and interviews are ongoing. For questions regarding the recruitment process, contact Adrian Lyng at Adrian.Lyng@se.ey.com. Start date by agreement. Please note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.
At EY, we promote an inclusive environment and value diversity. We encourage applications from candidates with different backgrounds and strive for a fair recruitment process. If you need support or adjustments, please contact us.

We are looking for a Business Analyst for a company in Gothenburg. Start is ASAP, 16 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg.

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst with strong solution understanding and the ability to bridge business needs with technical implementation.

Key Responsibilities

Develop a deep understanding of the solution, its functionality, and how it is used across the organization.

Collaborate with Business Owners and stakeholders to gather, clarify, and challenge new requirements by asking the right questions and identifying underlying business needs.

Assess the end-to-end impact of proposed changes and understand dependencies across related systems, processes, and solution components.

Translate business requirements into clear technical work items, functional specifications, user stories, and high-level solution designs or pseudocode.

Facilitate discussions and workshops with business stakeholders, SMEs, and technical teams to ensure alignment on requirements and proposed solutions.

Engage with Business SMEs and dealer representatives to collect feedback and incorporate insights into solution improvements.

Create wireframes and prototypes in Figma to support requirement elicitation and solution validation.

Work closely with Tech Leads, Solution Architects, SMEs, and DPOs throughout the delivery lifecycle.

Support testing activities by validating business logic, solution behavior, and requirement fulfillment.

Required Experience & Competencies

Proven experience working as a Business Analyst, Solution Analyst, or similar role in a complex business and technology environment.

Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with both business and technical audiences.

Understanding of Power BI and Power Pages.

Familiarity with Databricks and UDP (Unified Data Platform) concepts.

Experience working with queries, Excel, data entities, and data analysis.

Strong understanding of large datasets, multiple data sources, and data ingestion/integration flows.

Ability to analyze business processes and understand how changes affect upstream and downstream systems.

Experience supporting testing, validation, and quality assurance activities related to business requirements and solution logic.

Comfortable working in cross-functional teams involving business stakeholders, architects, technical leads, and subject matter experts.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in data-driven environments with complex integrations and reporting solutions.

Hands-on experience creating business process flows, prototypes, and requirement documentation.

Knowledge of end-to-end data flows, system integrations, and solution dependencies.

This role requires fluency in English.

This is a full-time consultant position in Gothenburg through Incluso. Start is ASAP, 16 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg.

 Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

Mission
Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.
In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.
Role Purpose
Be part of the medical technology revolution – Neko Health is expanding and looking for talented assistant nurses to join our team. Are you ready for an exciting career where you can make a real difference? This is your chance to become part of our dynamic team and help shape the exciting journey ahead!
In this role you will be at the center of our mission. Based at one of our futuristic Neko Health clinics in Central Stockholm, your main tasks will be to carry out examinations, collect clinical research data, take blood samples, analyse blood samples, and handle administrative documentation. You will be a key person in ensuring the smooth operation and high quality of our activities. You will work closely in teams with other skilled medical operators and experienced professionals, but you will also have the opportunity to take initiative and work independently.
We are looking for full-time assistant nurses who are comfortable working a variety of shifts, including daytime, evening, and Saturday shifts. The role requires a minimum commitment of one evening shift per week and one Saturday shift per month.
Minimum Qualifications
Relevant healthcare education as an assistant nurse.
Clinical skills: Confident in performing ECGs and blood sampling. Minimum of one year of clinical experience.
Excellent customer service skills: Warm, friendly, and professional approach. You are solution-oriented, flexible, and committed to delivering high-quality patient care.
Start-up mindset: Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Adaptable to change and digitally proficient with good technical skills.
Strong communication skills: Clear, structured, and pedagogical in your communication.
Language skills: Fluent in Swedish and highly proficient in English.

We offer a dynamic work environment with a high degree of autonomy that fosters growth and development. If you are passionate about building a better healthcare system for everyone and you thrive in a fast-paced environment, we would love to hear from you.
Interviews are ongoing, so don't hesitate to send in your application today!

jobs.occupation: Cyber Security Engineer  Industrial Control Systems
jobs.description:
På ABB hjälper vi industrier att bli mer resurseffektiva och renare – och varje person här bidrar till resultaten. Du kommer att få möjlighet att leda, få stöd att växa och kunna vara stolt över den påverkan vi skapar tillsammans. Gå med oss och hjälp till att driva det som driver världen.
Denna position rapporterar till:
Digital Lead - Regional
__
You’ll join ABB Energy Industries, part of ABB’s Automation division. We deliver electrical automation and digitalization solutions to industries including nuclear power, district heating, hydropower, water, pharmaceuticals and chemicals, using ABB’s industry-leading technologies.
In this role, you’ll help deliver our cybersecurity portfolio and make a meaningful difference for our customers.
Your responsibilities
Design and implement secure OT solutions and interfaces with IT systems. Assess cybersecurity risks, identify security gaps and recommend effective remedies.
Develop robust system and network architectures.
Assess and document the cybersecurity posture of OT systems and network infrastructure.
Implement disaster recovery solutions for OT systems.
Deliver security updates and foundational security controls as part of service agreements.
Provide services such as IT/OT system hardening, role-based access control and risk assessments, helping customers meet cybersecurity standards and requirements, including the NIS2 Directive.

Your background
You have a bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology or a related field—or equivalent experience. Most importantly, you bring practical experience with cybersecurity solutions and services, as well as OT/IT architecture or infrastructure.
Experience implementing cybersecurity solutions for control systems and/or SCADA is an advantage.
You understand network maintenance and troubleshooting, firewall configuration, routing protocols and network traffic monitoring.
Knowledge of Network Intrusion Detection (NID) and/or Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) is a plus.
Certifications such as GISP or ISA/IEC 62443 (IC32 or IC33) are advantageous.
You communicate confidently in Swedish and English, both spoken and written.

More about us
Recruiting Manager Krishna Kumar can answer questions about the position at +46 21 34 30 78. Union representatives: Sveriges Ingenjörer – Amanda Törn, +46 72 464 40 66; Unionen – Tony Johansson, +46 730 66 99 06; Ledarna – Lenny Larsson, +46 706 32 85 47. For other questions, contact Talent Partner Irma Leijon at +46 72 461 23 14.
Apply by December 4. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

Nobina Group, the largest public transport operator in the Nordics, is looking for a driven and ambitious Strategy & Business Development Lead who wants to help shape the future of our business.
In this role, you will work closely with our executive management to drive strategic development, business growth and long-term value creation. It is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys complex challenges, turning insights into action and making a real impact.

The Role & Your Impact
As Group Strategy Specialist, you will drive the development of Nobina’s group strategy and business planning process, working closely with our CEO, CFO and executive management to translate strategic ambitions into concrete plans and initiatives.
You will coordinate the executive management agenda, prepare strategic analyses and decision-making material for executive management and Board meetings, lead group-wide projects and support potential M&A opportunities.
Key Responsibilities:

Drive the development of Nobina’s group strategy and business planning process

Coordinate the executive management agenda in collaboration with the CEO and CFO

Prepare strategic analyses and decision-making material for executive management and Board meetings

Lead strategic, group-wide and cross-functional projects

Support the evaluation and development of M&A opportunities

What You Bring
We are looking for an ambitious and analytical person with a strategic mindset and the ability to turn ideas into action. You are comfortable navigating complex challenges, combine a hands-on approach with a strong business perspective and enjoy building relationships and engaging stakeholders across the organisation. You are also flexible, solution-oriented and motivated by driving change and achieving results.
To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

4–5+ years of experience as a management consultant or within strategy, business development or project management in a relevant organisation

Proven experience leading projects and collaborating across functions

Experience presenting and engaging with senior management and board-level stakeholders

A university degree in Business, Engineering or a related field

Strong digital proficiency and experience using digital tools to support analysis and collaboration

Fluency in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing

Why Nobina
At Nobina, we are committed to creating an inclusive work environment where every employee feels valued. Our leaders take responsibility, make courageous decisions, and consistently embrace an outside-in perspective to meet the needs of our passengers. By being business-driven and focusing on the bigger picture, we strive to develop our operations and create sustainable solutions for the future. Our culture is built on respect, care, and responsibility, and we constantly seek new perspectives to drive innovation.

More and more people are choosing Sellpy and we need to keep up by adding one more German-speaking colleague to the Customer Support team.
We hope you are inspired to change the world for the better through your work and helping our customers with a wide variety of challenges.
Sellpy’s vision is to empower everyone to live circularly. We believe that every item deserves a second life, and we see huge financial, social and environmental value in making sure this happens. We look for those who share this vision and have the grit to tackle the challenges of building a circular future.
Customer Support at Sellpy
The next German-speaking colleague will have an important role in enabling customers in the German market. Sellpy has customers selling and buying second hand products, and our team is responsible for supporting customers in both areas, over chat, phone and email when required. We specialise in unique items at Sellpy, which gives you plenty of fun challenges that you probably haven’t faced before.
In short, you will
Create satisfaction for our buyers and sellers in a wide variety of support errands
Pick up inquiries via chat, telephone and/or email
Learn lots about second hand in a fast-paced environment
Help to improve our service based on customer feedback

Requirements
A structured and service-minded mentality
Spoken and written fluency in German, at a near-native level
Good knowledge of English as this is our company language
An interest in finding solutions and improving the offer for our customers

We’d be impressed if you have
Additional language skills (French, Czech, Danish or Dutch)
Experience in a customer-facing role
Experience in working in customer support via chat, phone and email
An interest in second hand

You get to
Be part of a modern company that's driving the change towards a sustainable lifestyle. In return, you will develop and work on meaningful challenges on a daily basis
Join a vibrant office culture at Medborgarplatsen
Work with highly skilled and motivated colleagues
Enjoy staff discounts at Sellpy and the H&M brands (Arket, COS, Other Stories, Weekday & more)
Gain new skills with unlimited access to a learning platform

Location
On-site collaboration at our core, supported by a flexible hybrid setup. This specific role is based at our Medborgarplatsen office.
Form of employment: Full-time
Start: As agreed upon
Please note that only candidates who meet the requirement of spoken and written fluency in German will move forward in the screening process.

We are currently looking for aTechnical Lead to join an innovative vehicle systems team focused on developing locking, door, window, and access control functions for next-generation vehicle platforms.
About the Assignment
As a Technical Lead, you will play a key role in developing, defining, and verifying robust system solutions and customer-oriented functionality related to door control systems.
You will work with both existing and future vehicle architectures, ensuring system designs are scalable, safe, and aligned with overall vehicle requirements. The role combines systemization, requirements engineering, system modeling, safety analysis, and supplier collaboration within a highly cross-functional environment.

Door Control Systems
Locking Functions
Window Control Functions
Alarm and Access Features

Create and maintain system models and technical documentation.
Define technical solutions in alignment with system architecture guidelines.
Contribute to safety-related system development according to ISO 26262.
Participate in technical discussions with suppliers and engineering stakeholders.
Support system verification and validation activities.
Collaborate closely with software, hardware, function, and architecture teams.
Support the development of future vehicle user experiences through robust system design.

Minimum 4+ years of experience in:
System Design
Function Development
System Engineering
System Modeling

Strong experience in:
Requirement Engineering
Requirement Decomposition
Requirement Traceability
Experience working with safety-critical systems.
Practical knowledge of ISO 26262 Functional Safety.

Experience using:
Elektra
CarWeaver
Experience collaborating with suppliers and managing technical alignments.

M.Sc. in:
Systems Engineering
Control & Mechatronics
Computer Engineering
Engineering Physics
Or equivalent experience
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Meritorious Qualifications
Hardware design knowledge.
Experience with functional design methodologies.
Understanding of user behavior, customer journeys, and use-case-driven development.
Experience within automotive electrical architectures and vehicle systems development.
Knowledge of vehicle access, door module, locking, or closure systems.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking an experienced Design Engineer for a long-term consulting assignment focused on chassis integration for battery-electric heavy-duty vehicle solutions. The role covers the mechanical design and integration of components and systems within the chassis, including sheet metal structures, brackets and installation solutions, pneumatic components and installations, component packaging, and chassis integration. Experience in at least one of these areas is required, while broader experience spanning multiple areas is advantageous.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop mechanical components, brackets, and installation solutions for heavy-duty vehicle chassis.
Produce and maintain 3D models and 2D engineering drawings using CATIA V5 and applicable design standards.
Manage component packaging, mechanical interfaces, tolerances, and installation requirements within the chassis environment.
Develop solutions involving sheet metal, plastic, and pneumatic components, with consideration for manufacturing feasibility.
Collaborate with suppliers and cross-functional engineering teams throughout the development process.
Participate in design reviews, validation activities, and technical investigations.
Maintain accurate technical and engineering documentation.
Provide technical support to production when required.
Independently plan and drive assigned design activities while contributing to technical knowledge sharing within the team.

Technical Stack & Requirements
CAD: CATIA V5 for both 3D modeling and 2D engineering drawings.
Mechanical design: Strong competence in sheet metal design and/or pneumatic system design.
Engineering analysis: Practical experience with tolerance analysis and the management of mechanical interfaces.
Vehicle integration: Understanding of component packaging, installation constraints, and chassis integration.
Manufacturing: Knowledge of design-for-manufacturability principles, particularly for sheet metal, plastic, and/or pneumatic components.
Development environment: Previous R&D experience involving heavy-duty vehicle development.

Qualifications & Experience
A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline is required, together with at least three years of design engineering experience. Candidates must have previous research and development experience from heavy-duty vehicle development, hands-on CATIA V5 competence, and a strong background in sheet metal and/or pneumatic design. Previous experience with chassis design and installation for heavy-duty vehicles is advantageous, as is experience combining several of the relevant technical disciplines. The role requires the ability to drive design work independently and collaborate effectively with suppliers and cross-functional teams. Fluency in English is required.

jobs.occupation: Take your nursing career to Northern Norway
jobs.description:
Imagine building your nursing career in one of Europe’s most spectacular regions, surrounded by Arctic nature, close-knit communities and a healthcare system where your skills are truly valued.
We are recruiting EU-trained nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Finnmark, Northern Norway. You will mainly work within home care services or nursing homes, providing important care and becoming part of an experienced and supportive healthcare team.
Moving to another country is a big step, but you will not have to do it alone. We provide free Norwegian language training, assistance with authorisation, relocation support and personal follow-up throughout the entire process.
Your main responsibilities include:
Providing home nursing care to patients in their own homes
Working in a nursing home or assisted living facility
Daily patient follow-up, medication management, observation and documentation
Close collaboration with relatives, GPs and other healthcare professionals
Contributing to quality improvement and development of local routines

We are looking for someone who:
Has a valid license as a nurse from an EU/EEA country
Is motivated to obtain Norwegian authorisation (we assist with the process)
Speak fluent English and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian
Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language course
Works independently and in a structured way
Enjoys teamwork and has genuine compassion for patients
Is flexible and able to adapt to different work situations
Holds a driver’s license 

We offer:
A full-time permanent position
Competitive salary and working conditions
A warm, inclusive and supportive team
Opportunities for professional development
Free online Norwegian language course with a private teacher
Relocation assistance and help with housing
Personal follow-up throughout the recruitment and relocation process

Why Finnmark?
Finnmark is Norway’s northernmost region and offers a different pace of life than larger cities. Here, you will find close-knit communities and easy access to nature.
Many international healthcare professionals choose Finnmark because of the combination of meaningful work, affordable living and attractive financial benefits. The region also offers unique experiences throughout the year, from the midnight sun in summer to the northern lights during winter.
As a nurse in the municipal healthcare services, you will play an important role in the local community and work closely with patients, relatives and colleagues in a supportive and collaborative environment.
Financial benefits of working in Finnmark:
Lower income tax rate (18.5% compared to 22% in the rest of Norway)
Additional annual tax deduction of up to NOK 45,000
No electricity consumption tax for households
Free kindergarten (meal costs may apply)
Additional child benefit for families with children

Apply today or get in touch with us for more information.

You'll set priorities, support day-to-day operations, and develop the team through coaching and continuous improvement. You'll work closely with colleagues across the organization to improve performance and meet customer needs.
 
Who are you?
You are an engaged and goal-oriented leader and team player who enjoys building dynamic teams that deliver long-term results. You thrive on inspiring, leading and collaborating with others in a global and operational environment. You are a coaching and results-oriented leader with a focus on the bigger picture.
 
 
What you know

Experience leading people, including personnel responsibility.

Professional fluency in Swedish and English.

 
What we offer
We offer you a challenging position in an international, open and friendly environment where we help one another develop and create value for our customers.
 
This position is based in Flemingsberg, in the south of Stockholm, Sweden.

About the Role
You love making things work. You're not in love with a specific solution or technology, but rather delivering value to users.

Experience with authentication and authorization

jobs.occupation: The Royal Opera Chorus is seeking a Tenor 1
jobs.description:
The artistic director of the Royal Swedish Opera Tobias Theorell and Chorus master Jori Klomp invites to audition.
The Chorus of the Royal Swedish Opera is Sweden’s largest professional chorus and one of the oldest in the world, founded in 1773. The chorus consists of 48 full-time choristers who take part in the vast majority of all opera productions, which are performed throughout the season. 
The position 
Tenor 1, full-time, permanent employment with probationary year commencing the 1st of July 2027 or by agreement. 
Your profile
Details of education in music or postgraduate studies in opera are requested, and further details of experience as a member of an opera chorus are desirable.
You should have a good proficiency in either English or Swedish. If you cannot currently speak Swedish you are expected to learn.
Audition
The Audition will take place on Saturday the 27th of February 2027, by invitation and upon review of applications.
Please prepare the following for audition:
Mandatory aria (choose one of them):
Tenor 1 
Un aura amorosa (Così fan tutte)
Che gelida manina (La Bohème)
Pourqoui me reveiller (Werther)
One aria of your own choice in contrasting language and style to that of the mandatory aria.
The audition will also involve tests in sight-reading, chorus excerpts, stagecraft and an ensemble test.
The chorus excerpts and ensembles will be sent after invitation.
Your application 
Applications must be received no later than the 24th of January 2027. 
To be approved your application must be accompanied by CV, an attached mp3 sound file and photograph.
 
The mp3 sound file and the photo should be uploaded in the section "Other documents".
Apply at https://www.operan.se/en/careers by clicking on the button APPLY.
Union representative: Louise Reitberger, +46 8 791 43 00
Please address all questions to mailto:korprovsjungning@operan.se
 
As Sweden’s national stage for opera and ballet, the Royal Swedish Opera is committed to offering access to everyone and to inspiring strong emotions. Our values are expressed as Excellence, Welcoming, Fearless and Timeless. The Royal Swedish Opera is a limited company that is wholly-owned by the State with a turnover of c. SEK 600 million and with some 700 employees from over 20 countries representing 120 different professions.With over 200 opera and ballet performances, hundreds of concerts and several hundred activities for the young, each season offers a wide range of experiences – both within and outside of the opera house. The repertoire includes both classical and new works spanning from the Early to the Modern period.
